package.author: Primate Labs Inc.
package.description: Measures your device's CPU and GPU performance.

en-US.author: Primate Labs Inc.
en-US.description: Measures your device's CPU and GPU performance.
en-US.longDescription: Geekbench 7 is a cross-platform benchmark that measures your system's performance with the press of a button. Geekbench 7 features new and improved CPU and GPU workloads that model real-world tasks and applications, new media workloads that measure how well your CPU handles audio and video encoding, decoding, and processing, and a redesigned GPU benchmark with new image editing and synthesis tests. How will your computer perform when push comes to crunch? How will it compare to the newest devices on the market? Find out today with Geekbench 7.
en-US.name: Geekbench 7

zh-CN.description: 测量你设备的 CPU 和 GPU 性能。
zh-CN.longDescription: Geekbench 7 是一款跨平台基准测试软件，只需按一下按钮即可测量系统性能。Geekbench 7 提供全新和改进的 CPU 与 GPU 工作负载，模拟真实世界的任务和应用；新增测量 CPU 处理音频、视频编码、解码与处理的媒体工作负载，并重新设计了包含全新图像编辑与合成测试的 GPU 基准测试。你的电脑在重负载下表现如何？与市面上的最新设备相比又如何？立即用 Geekbench 7 一探究竟。
